# Loan

**Definition.** The period during which a member holds a book outside the
library.

**In context.** A loan starts when a book is checked out and ends when it is
returned.

**Distinguish from.** A reservation, which precedes a loan and does not yet
remove the book from the shelf.

> [!note] Notes
> None.
